# Software Engineer - Java & Spring Boot

## Professional Summary
Experienced Java Backend Developer with over 5 years of expertise in designing, building, and scaling robust enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and Cloud technologies.

## Skills
- **Languages:** Java, SQL, Python
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, JUnit
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB
- **Tools & DevOps:** Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Git, Maven, CI/CD

## Experience
### Senior Backend Engineer | TechCorp Inc. (2021 - Present)
- Developed high-throughput microservices using Java 17 and Spring Boot.
- Implemented secure RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.
- Optimized PostgreSQL query performance, reducing API response times by 35%.

### Software Developer | Innovate Solutions (2018 - 2021)
- Built and maintained core banking APIs using Spring Boot and Hibernate.
- Automated deployment pipelines utilizing Docker and Jenkins on AWS EC2.
